FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are offered by the dentist in Wilmington – Monkey Junction?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

Is same-day or emergency dental care available in Wilmington – Monkey Junction?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Does the Wilmington – Monkey Junction office offer family and pediatric dentistry?

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and families with pediatric dental care comfortably and comprehensively, as they deserve.

What cosmetic dentistry options are available in Wilmington – Monkey Junction?

We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Are dental implants available at the Wilmington – Monkey Junction location?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including dental implants.

How often should I schedule cleanings and oral exams in Wilmington – Monkey Junction?

We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

Does Wilmington – Monkey Junction offer oral cancer screening and fluoride treatment?

Yes, we offer oral cancer screenings. Early cancer detection is critical for proper treatment and recovery. Your health is our priority.

Does the Wilmington – Monkey Junction office perform wisdom teeth removal?

Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.

Can I get Invisalign® or clear aligners at Wilmington – Monkey Junction?

Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign® needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What types of dental services are offered for families and children in Leland?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

How do I schedule a dental appointment at the Leland office?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Do you offer same-day crowns or restorations in Leland?

Yes! By using the cutting-edge CAD/CAM technology, we are able to offer same-day crowns that provide permanent, custom-fit, and natural-looking metal-free restoration.

Can I get dental implants or a consultation at your Leland location?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available. 

Are emergency dental appointments available in Leland?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Leland location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Does the Leland office offer cosmetic treatments like whitening or veneers?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

What hours is the Leland office open, and is Saturday available?

Our office Hours are Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Do you accept dental insurance or offer payment plans in Leland?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Where is the Leland office located, and what parking/accessibility is available?

Our office in Leland is located at 1215 West Gate Drive, Suite 180, Leland, NC 28451. We provide free parking, and the parking lot includes wheelchair-accessible spaces to accommodate all visitors.

Dr. Ben Rowland grew up in Virginia and attended Virginia Commonwealth University where he obtained both his undergraduate degree and his Doctor of Dental Surgery.

Prior to attending college, Dr. Rowland was a Navy Corpsman (medic) working with the US Marine Corps. While he was deployed to Iraq in 2005, Dr. Rowland’s brother sent him a letter that contained an article titled “The Most Rewarding Professions.” Being a dentist was at the top of the list. That letter opened Dr. Rowland’s eyes to a way that he could still practice medicine, but not have the life-and-death weight of working in a war zone. Dr. Rowland has been exposed to and has experience in all aspects of general dentistry. He is passionate about treating his patients the way he would want his own family to be treated.
When he’s not in the office, Dr. Rowland loves to read and spend time with his wife and their 6 children.

Dr. Freag grew up in Cairo, Egypt, where he earned his Bachelor of Dental Surgery degree from October 6 University in 2009. Inspired by his mother’s work as a dentist, he developed a passion for helping others through compassionate, high-quality care. After gaining extensive experience in Egypt as a general dentist with a focus on implant surgeries, prosthodontics, and special needs care, he completed advanced training through the German Board of Oral Implantology and additional certifications in orthodontics and restorative dentistry. After relocating to the United States, Dr. Freag contributed to dental research at Rutgers University before graduating at the top of his class from the International Dentist Program at Virginia Commonwealth University School of Dentistry.

Dr. Freag is passionate about esthetic and comprehensive dental care, with special interests in veneers, Invisalign, composite restorations, and implant-supported prosthetics. His approach emphasizes minimally invasive techniques, precision, and a patient-first philosophy centered on building trust and delivering exceptional outcomes.

Outside the office, Dr. Freag enjoys spending time with his wife, Sheri — also a dental student — and their two children, Evin and Emily. He is deeply rooted in his Christian faith and finds joy in music, grilling, and hosting family and friends.

Dentistry centered around you

At Commonwealth Dentistry in Palmyra, you are at the center of everything we do. Our Palmyra dentists and dental team are ready to help you and your family in whatever way you need to have the best version of your smile. Here, appointments start on time and we are always focused on ensuring you have a fulfilling and comfortable experience in the dental chair.

Same-day Appointments Available

Experiencing a dental emergency? We’ll do our best to see you the very same day and get you back to feeling like yourself.

Meet Our Palmyra Dentists
Dr. Benjamin Rowland

Dr. Ben Rowland grew up in Virginia and attended Virginia Commonwealth University where he obtained both his undergraduate degree and his Doctor of Dental Surgery.

Prior to attending college, Dr. Rowland was a Navy Corpsman (medic) working with the US Marine Corps. While he was deployed to Iraq in 2005, Dr. Rowland’s brother sent him a letter that contained an article titled “The Most Rewarding Professions.” Being a dentist was at the top of the list. That letter opened Dr. Rowland’s eyes to a way that he could still practice medicine, but not have the life-and-death weight of working in a war zone. Dr. Rowland has been exposed to and has experience in all aspects of general dentistry. He is passionate about treating his patients the way he would want his own family to be treated.

When he’s not in the office, Dr. Rowland loves to read and spend time with his wife and their 6 children.

Dr. Peter Freag

Dr. Freag grew up in Cairo, Egypt, where he earned his Bachelor of Dental Surgery degree from October 6 University in 2009. Inspired by his mother’s work as a dentist, he developed a passion for helping others through compassionate, high-quality care. After gaining extensive experience in Egypt as a general dentist with a focus on implant surgeries, prosthodontics, and special needs care, he completed advanced training through the German Board of Oral Implantology and additional certifications in orthodontics and restorative dentistry. After relocating to the United States, Dr. Freag contributed to dental research at Rutgers University before graduating at the top of his class from the International Dentist Program at Virginia Commonwealth University School of Dentistry.

Dr. Freag is passionate about esthetic and comprehensive dental care, with special interests in veneers, Invisalign, composite restorations, and implant-supported prosthetics. His approach emphasizes minimally invasive techniques, precision, and a patient-first philosophy centered on building trust and delivering exceptional outcomes.

Outside the office, Dr. Freag enjoys spending time with his wife, Sheri — also a dental student — and their two children, Evin and Emily. He is deeply rooted in his Christian faith and finds joy in music, grilling, and hosting family and friends.

Grant H. Shaw, DDS, is a native of Beaverdam, VA, in Hanover County, and a proud graduate of Patrick Henry High School in Ashland, VA. His journey into dentistry began in 9th grade while shadowing a family friend who was a dentist. Dentistry captivated him because it combines fine hand skills, science, artistry, engineering, and health care, allowing him to improve smiles, alleviate pain, and enhance confidence and quality of life.

Dr. Shaw completed his undergraduate studies at the University of Virginia in Charlottesville, VA, and earned his dental degree from Virginia Commonwealth University in Richmond, VA. In his practice, Dr. Shaw is dedicated to transforming people’s perception of the “dentist” by providing positive, anxiety-free appointments. He focuses on relieving pain, restoring smiles, and enhancing patients’ confidence and quality of life.

Outside of work, Dr. Shaw enjoys spending time with his wife, Melissa, exploring the outdoors. He loves fishing, hunting, hiking, boating, and traveling to the beach, lake, and river. He also enjoys golfing with friends, playing tennis, watching sports, and discovering new restaurants and cuisines. Dr. Shaw is excited to serve the Hanover community that helped raise him.

Dentistry centered around you

At Commonwealth Dentistry in Mechanicsville, we do all we can to deliver you a smile you can be proud of. Our team of friendly Mechanicsville dentists and dental professionals offer the latest treatments and are dedicated to providing outstanding care in a comfortable environment. We are so excited to be joining the community to help bring healthy smiles to Mechanicsville!

 

We offer comprehensive general, cosmetic, and restorative treatments in-office, ensuring that no matter what you face on your dental journey, you can always get the care you need from a dental team you trust.

Our Mechanicsville dentistry services include:

General Dentistry
Cosmetic Dentistry
Broad Network of Insurance Accepted

We accept most major insurance plans as well as many regional plans. For those without insurance, take advantage of our in-house discount plan.

Convenient Appointments

At Commonwealth Dentistry, you always come first. Our appointments always start on time and exceed expectations.

Multi-Specialty Dental Practice

Our Mechanicsville dentist office offers comprehensive general and cosmetic treatments and works with other Commonwealth locations to provide specialty treatment.

Same-day Appointments Available

Are you experiencing a dental emergency? We offer same-day visits to get you back to feeling like yourself.

Meet Your Mechanicsville Dentist
Dr. Grant H. Shaw

Grant H. Shaw, DDS, is a native of Beaverdam, VA, in Hanover County, and a proud graduate of Patrick Henry High School in Ashland, VA. His journey into dentistry began in 9th grade while shadowing a family friend who was a dentist. Dentistry captivated him because it combines fine hand skills, science, artistry, engineering, and health care, allowing him to improve smiles, alleviate pain, and enhance confidence and quality of life.

Dr. Shaw completed his undergraduate studies at the University of Virginia in Charlottesville, VA, and earned his dental degree from Virginia Commonwealth University in Richmond, VA. In his practice, Dr. Shaw is dedicated to transforming people’s perception of the “dentist” by providing positive, anxiety-free appointments. He focuses on relieving pain, restoring smiles, and enhancing patients’ confidence and quality of life.

Outside of work, Dr. Shaw enjoys spending time with his wife, Melissa, exploring the outdoors. He loves fishing, hunting, hiking, boating, and traveling to the beach, lake, and river. He also enjoys golfing with friends, playing tennis, watching sports, and discovering new restaurants and cuisines. Dr. Shaw is excited to serve the Hanover community that helped raise him.

schemaMarkup.reviewBody: Best Cleaning I’ve had in a long time!!! My hygienist was very thorough, and you can tell she took pride in what she did and how her work was. My teeth felt amazing after and still do. I had a very enjoyable time at my appointment. I also came to them for a previous filling that had cracked, and now I had a hole in my tooth. The dentist was amazing! The office was able to schedule me sooner than later. I also couldn’t have asked for a better Dentist! He was knowledgeable, and you can tell he was a perfectionist who took pride in great work. I was in good hands. My tooth feels amazing and is back to being normal. I won’t be seeing anyone else. Great staff, very helpful, polite, and professional. Thank you so much to everyone there!

Just had my first visit to Riccobene Associates in Wake Forest, and they went above and beyond in my opinion. I had scheduled a cleaning, and the dental hygienist was thorough in her examination and, as a new patient, thankfully asked how long ago I enrolled in my dental insurance before she performed the cleaning. When I said we switched dental insurance 5 months ago, she double-checked with the office manager on my insurance coverage. The office manager was caring and polite, and informed me that my insurance would not cover a cleaning until after the first six months of coverage. She let me schedule a cleaning for one month later instead. This shows me that they care about not just their patients' dental health but also saving them money when they can. I, for one, really appreciated that. I will be back.

I have had a couple of chips on my front tooth that have been bothering me for a few years. I’ve been told by a couple of other dentists that the chips could only be reshaped, but not filled, which I did not want because I wanted my natural tooth shape. The doctor fixed everything so perfectly and made it look exactly like my natural tooth. He respected my wishes not to shave down my natural tooth and talked me through every step. He is extremely patient, professional, and artistic with the tooth compositing. I am so happy and can’t believe how good my teeth look. His assistant was also so patient and warm. I’m very happy and highly recommend!!

The entire staff took good care of me and made me feel at home. Honestly, the dentist's office has NEVER been my Happy Place, but they went above and beyond to give me a good experience. Personable, caring, attentive, and professional. The hygienist was very gentle but thorough. Thank you to the entire staff.

The team at Wake Forest Riccobene has been very welcoming to me and my family of 5. The doctor is professional, caring, thoughtful, and has a good sense of humor. His assistants explain everything so well. We have seen both hygienists and even some temps when they were out on vacation, and had nothing but a pleasant experience. The office is very cozy; it's not a huge office, which I like. Don't hesitate to give them a try!!!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are available at your Wake Forest office?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

What cosmetic dentistry options do you offer in Wake Forest?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Can I get emergency dental care the same day in Wake Forest?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do you offer dental implants or other restorative solutions at Wake Forest?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants, bridges, dentures, and crowns.

How often should I schedule routine checkups and cleanings in Wake Forest?

We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

What X-ray technology do you use to ensure safe modern dental care in Wake Forest?

We use digital X-rays, which have a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.

Do you perform wisdom teeth removal at your Wake Forest office?

Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.

Do you screen for oral cancer at your Wake Forest dental practice?

Yes, we offer oral cancer screenings. Early cancer detection is critical for proper treatment and recovery. Your health is our priority.

Welcome to our Selma office! Right at the intersection of Interstate 95 U.S. and Route 70, our Selma location provides care for the Selma community and for patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Smithfield, Wilson’s Mills, Goldsboro, and more. With our highly advanced technology and an experienced team, we provide the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, pain-free smile!

Our modern, inviting space is filled with a professional, experienced team that strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we strive for our office and amenities to be designed with our patients’ health and well-being in mind. Situated in a suburban community that blends small-town charm with convenient access to the Walmart Shopping Center, this location is accessible and easy to travel to. Our Selma office stands out with its peaceful atmosphere, where patients feel supported and leave motivated to take care of their oral health with ease and comfort.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Selma office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
At our office, we provide all the necessary treatments, including traditional metal and ceramic braces, Invisalign® clear aligners, retainers for maintenance, and more!

Caring for your braces is highly important to maintaining proper oral hygiene. Therefore, we will provide you with a special care kit with the necessary tools to take care of your braces properly. We also encourage you to brush your teeth after every meal to keep your smile bright and healthy.

For braces, you will typically visit every 4–8 weeks, while for Invisalign®, visits are usually every 6–10 weeks. For post-treatment retainers, visits are around 3–6 months to ensure proper maintenance.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

What orthodontic treatments are offered at Selma, NC, Orthodontics?

At our office, we provide all the necessary treatments, including traditional metal and ceramic braces, Invisalign® clear aligners, retainers for maintenance, and more!

How do I take care of my braces and teeth during treatment?

Caring for your braces is highly important to maintaining proper oral hygiene. Therefore, we will provide you with a special care kit with the necessary tools to take care of your braces properly. We also encourage you to brush your teeth after every meal to keep your smile bright and healthy.

How often do I need to visit Selma, NC, Orthodontics during treatment?

For braces, you will typically visit every 4–8 weeks, while for Invisalign®, visits are usually every 6–10 weeks. For post-treatment retainers, visits are around 3–6 months to ensure proper maintenance.

Treating childhood dental needs, much like their medical needs, isn’t just a matter of providing the same care as adults require in a smaller mouth. Children are growing and developing, as are their mouth and teeth. We treat the unique needs of children as they mature in an environment designed for their comfort and staff who are expert at dealing with anxious, nervous, or animated during their appointment.

Thumb-sucking or pacifier use can cause dental issues if thumb-sucking or pacifier use persist past several years of age, particularly as permanent teeth begin to appear. Consult your dentist if you have concerns or questions about your child’s oral habits and experts can help you develop a plan to address their healthy dental development.

Regular brushing and flossing are the best way to prevent cavities at home, as well as starting and maintaining a regular dental care cadence as soon as your child’s teeth begin emerging. It’s never too early to establish good dental habits.

Both sealants and fluoride treatment are recommended to prevent cavities. Your dentist can explain the rule of fluoride to strengthen enamel and sealants to create a protective layer over areas of your child’s teeth that are prone to cavities and help you understand whether either sealants, fluoride, or both would be helpful for your child.

A child’s first dental visit should be as soon as practicable after teeth have begun emerging, ideally within six months of getting their first tooth. Establishing regular, routine dental care early in life sets the stage for a lifetime of smiles.

How often should I visit a dentist in Knightdale for checkups?

Regular cleanings are recommended as a twice-per-year activity for everyone. Keeping on top of your dental routines can prevent major problems down the road, so book your checkup today.

Do Knightdale dentists offer pediatric dental care?

Yes - we offer are for the whole family at our Knightdale location.

Do Knightdale dental offices accept insurance and payment plans?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Can a Knightdale dentist help with cosmetic treatments like teeth whitening or veneers?

Yes, we offer cosmetic treatments like professional tooth whitening, veneers, Invisalign® and more. If you have concerns for how your teeth look, give us a call today and we’ll help you explore options.

Do dentists in Knightdale offer emergency dental care?

At Commonwealth Dentistry in Midlothian, we’re dedicated to creating a positive, personalized experience for every child who walks through our doors. From the moment they arrive, our team goes above and beyond to ensure young patients feel safe, supported, and genuinely cared for.

Our providers are trained to meet the unique needs of growing smiles, offering gentle, age-appropriate treatments in a fun and welcoming environment. Every aspect of our care is centered around your child’s long-term oral health and emotional well-being, helping them build confidence in the dentist’s chair and develop healthy habits that last a lifetime.
With punctual scheduling and a friendly team, we make every pediatric visit simple and stress-free from start to finish.
We tailor each visit to your child’s comfort with gentle care and clear communication to help them feel calm and confident.
We work with most major and regional insurance plans and offer an in-house discount for families without coverage.

Dr. Kristin Robertson grew up in Centreville, Virginia, and earned her Bachelor of Science from James Madison University and Doctor of Dental Surgery from Virginia Commonwealth University. Her passion for dentistry began early, working as a dental assistant for her childhood dentist. During dental school, she volunteered with organizations like Mission of Mercy and Give Kids A Smile, sparking her commitment to serving children. After working in public health with a focus on pediatric care, Dr. Robertson found her true calling as a general dentist who enjoys providing care to patients of all ages—especially children.

Now back in Richmond, Dr. Robertson combines her professional expertise with her experience as a mother of two to create a welcoming, supportive environment for families. She emphasizes education, prevention, and personalized care to empower children and parents alike.

Outside the office, she enjoys time with her family, volunteering at St. Christopher’s and St. Catherine’s schools, and traveling for beach trips and ski weekends. Dr. Robertson looks forward to making your child’s dental visits both fun and educational!

At Commonwealth Dentistry, we believe dental care should be personalized to your needs and comfort. We strive to always provide a premier experience for our patients and the entire Chesapeake community. With our convenient appointments, comprehensive services, and experienced team, feel good knowing that no matter what you are going through, we’ll be here to help.

We are excited to join the Chesapeake community and empower the dentists you know and trust to continue providing top-level care. We offer comprehensive general, cosmetic, and restorative care in our comfortable and convenient Chesapeake dentist office.
Our Chesapeake dental services include:
We accept most major insurance plans as well as many regional plans. For those without insurance, take advantage of our in-house discount plan.
At our office, you always come first. Our appointments always start on time and exceed expectations.
Our Chesapeake dentist office offers comprehensive general and cosmetic treatments and works with other Commonwealth locations to provide specialty treatment.
Experiencing a dental emergency? We can generally get you in the very same day to get you feeling better.

With over 18 years of experience, Angela Lanier, DDS is an exceptional dentist with advanced skills in both general and cosmetic dentistry. Using modern, state-of-the-art dental procedures, materials, and equipment, Dr. Lanier can fix anything from a broken or decayed tooth to a complete and pain-free smile makeover.
She is a graduate of Meharry Medical College and is proud to have served as a dentist for the U.S. Navy. She holds additional certifications in nitrous oxide sedation and Invisalign®.

Dr. Keiara Evans is originally from Chesapeake, VA. She completed her Bachelor of Science degree in Biology from Norfolk State University and then relocated to the D.C. metro area where she received her Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from Howard University. She continued her education with a residency in Advanced Education in General Dentistry at NYU Langone, in Brooklyn, NY. Upon completion, she returned to Chesapeake to provide exceptional dental care to the residents of her hometown and surrounding areas.

Dr. Evans is a current member of the American Dental Association, Virginia Dental Association, and American Association of Women Dentists. She is the proud mother of one daughter. In her free time, Dr. Evans finds much joy in spending quality time with her family.

Meet Your Chesapeake Dentists
Dr. Angela Lanier

With over 18 years of experience, Angela Lanier, DDS is an exceptional dentist with advanced skills in both general and cosmetic dentistry. Using modern, state-of-the-art dental procedures, materials, and equipment, Dr. Lanier can fix anything from a broken or decayed tooth to a complete and pain-free smile makeover.

She is a graduate of Meharry Medical College and is proud to have served as a dentist for the U.S. Navy. She holds additional certifications in nitrous oxide sedation and Invisalign®.

Dr. Keiara Evans

Dr. Keiara Evans is originally from Chesapeake, VA. She completed her Bachelor of Science degree in Biology from Norfolk State University and then relocated to the D.C. metro area where she received her Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from Howard University. She continued her education with a residency in Advanced Education in General Dentistry at NYU Langone, in Brooklyn, NY. Upon completion, she returned to Chesapeake to provide exceptional dental care to the residents of her hometown and surrounding areas.

Dr. Evans is a current member of the American Dental Association, Virginia Dental Association, and American Association of Women Dentists. She is the proud mother of one daughter. In her free time, Dr. Evans finds much joy in spending quality time with her family.
